Name: Mizpah in Gilead
Description: The Mizpah of Gilead: the heap of stones Jacob and Laban raised as witness between them, which Jacob called Mizpah, and the town where Jephthah later spoke all his words before the LORD and was made head of Gilead.
BiblicalSignificance: Two covenants meet at this Mizpah — Jacob's parting witness with Laban, “The LORD watch between me and thee,” and Jephthah's vow before the LORD — both set in the Transjordan highlands, far from Benjamin's Mizpah.
KeyScriptures: Genesis 31:47; Genesis 31:48; Genesis 31:49; Judges 10:17; Judges 11:11; Judges 11:29; Judges 11:34; Hosea 5:1
RelatedPeople: Jacob; Laban; Jephthah, Judge of Israel
